reason: This is the only offered action, and it follows the population toward connective-tissue work.
expectation: The signaling environment will guide some cells toward a fibroblast identity, though the intermediate steps are unclear.

effect: The signaling environment led a subset toward fibroblasts and activated a collagen gene, producing messenger RNA for ribosomes.
reaction: The link from a surface signal to gene activity is interesting, though the mesoderm precursor is unexplained.
reason: The only offered combination supplies building blocks for making the protein specified by the messenger RNA.
expectation: Ribosomes will use the messenger RNA and amino acids to make a collagen precursor, likely at the rough ER.

effect: The fibroblasts now produce procollagen in the ER and Golgi; the next goal is to build extracellular material.
reaction: The RNA-to-protein connection is clear, though procollagen itself is not explained here.
reason: The only offered combination should move procollagen toward secretion.
expectation: Secretory vesicles will carry procollagen from the Golgi to the cell surface and release it outside.

effect: Vesicles released procollagen outside the fibroblasts, ready for extracellular processing.
reaction: The continuity from gene message to secreted material is satisfying.
reason: The only offered combination processes the secreted precursor into extracellular collagen.
expectation: The enzymes will clip procollagen and help form cross-linked collagen fibers.

effect: Processing produced cross-linked collagen fibers that resist tension; the remaining combination can add the hydrated gel.
reaction: The tension arrows make the fibers' structural role clear.
reason: The only offered combination brings collagen fibers together with the water-rich extracellular gel.
expectation: The fibers and hydrated proteoglycans will form extracellular connective-tissue material, though the precise result is uncertain.

effect: The collagen fibers and hydrated proteoglycans formed an extracellular matrix, completing the goal while keeping the fibroblasts distinct from the material around them.
reaction: The cell-versus-matrix inset is a useful clarification.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following collagen from an activated gene through protein production and secretion was most worthwhile: the picture plans connect gene expression to material made outside the cell.

leastWorthwhile.text: The amino-acid combination was straightforward but less engaging as a decision because it was the only offered combination; the result also introduced procollagen without explaining the term there.

surprise.text: The signaling environment led through a mesoderm precursor to fibroblasts while other descendants remained separate. Mesoderm was not explained, however.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although every decision offered only one combination, so the sequence involved little meaningful choice.

continue.text: I would be interested in another chapter to see how the matrix contributes to a tissue, though I would hope for more meaningful choices.
